name: Packaging Utah - A Division of Traco
old_description: Since 1985, we’ve made some impressive printing advances. Let us show you what we can do with a little plastic, paper, and ink. Your products will never look the same.
about:
Packaging Utah, a division of Traco Manufacturing Inc., has operated from Orem, Utah since 1985. The privately-owned business began as a packaging distributor and importer focused exclusively on serving Utah companies.

The company distributes a broad line of stock packaging supplies including corrugated boxes, stretch and shrink films, bags, tape, cushioning, and janitorial products. It also provides custom packaging design using CAD systems, digital label printing, shrink sleeve converting, and on-demand digital printing for runs from ten to over ten thousand units. Packaging Utah supplies equipment such as label applicators and heat tunnels alongside its materials.

Packaging Utah serves small, midsize, and large businesses throughout Utah, including product manufacturers needing custom labels for bottles and food containers, retail-ready flexible packaging, and multi-pack bundling. Its customer base spans companies requiring shipping supplies, void fill, and facility maintenance products.

The company positions itself as a one-stop packaging distributor for Utah businesses, combining stock and custom capabilities with local delivery and consulting support. It emphasizes quick, convenient shipping from its Orem facility and the flexibility of digital printing for short or long runs.
